laravel.runtime: tenant-scoped shared cache/Redis registry with atomic lock-protected replacement, cancellation and disposal semantics

acceptance.register_replace: A registration replaces the current job attempt and resets cancellation state.
acceptance.try_cancel: Cancellation succeeds only for a registered job and is idempotently successful once requested.
acceptance.is_registered: Registration presence is observable only inside the active tenant namespace.
acceptance.replacement_safe_disposal: A stale retry registration cannot unregister a newer replacement.
acceptance.retry_safety: Cancellation probes are registration-token scoped so stale retries cannot consume replacement intent.
acceptance.tenant_isolation: Identical job UUIDs in two tenants have independent registry state.
acceptance.queue_scheduler_semantics: State uses Laravel's shared cache/Redis control plane so queue workers and scheduler processes observe the same tenant-scoped cancellation intent.
acceptance.bounded_lifetime: Registrations are TTL bounded to prevent abandoned worker state from leaking indefinitely.
acceptance.invalid_identity: Invalid UUIDs and invalid TTLs fail closed.
